  TAIL DEFENSE  launcher keys

  Keys  any key closes

  everywhere  ↑↓ k j tab    move
              enter         choose
              esc q         back; quit from the menu
              ?             this help
              u             td update now, when one waits or a host asks
              R             restart into the new td after an update
              ctrl+c        quit
  host        ← →           the difficulty to host at
              w             how long: 20, 30 or 40 waves, or endless
              f             fog of war on or off
              y             copy the command friends join with
  join        r             look again now (it does every 5 s)
              a             type an address: host, host:port or IP
  changelog   ↑↓ pgup pgdn  scroll
              r             read the changelog again
  doctor      r             run the checks again
  settings    enter         edit a setting, or flip an on/off one
              esc           cancel an edit













  any key closes
